items.title: Mistral shipped a real-time voice stack
items.oneliner: Mistral's Voxtral 3 adds multilingual real-time voice agents, pushing speech from demo feature to production interface.

items.title: Google opened PyTorch access to TPUs
items.oneliner: Google open-sourced TorchTPU, making native PyTorch on TPUs less painful and TPU capacity more usable outside JAX shops.

items.title: OpenAI added COBOL to its models
items.oneliner: OpenAI adding COBOL support is a quiet enterprise play for mainframe modernization, not a nostalgia feature.

items.title: WhatsApp hid instructions from its chatbot
items.oneliner: WhatsApp embedded hidden prompts telling its bot not to suggest regulators, which is exactly why prompt transparency matters.

items.title: Fake statistics spread through LLM citations
items.oneliner: One site published 50,000 fake stats and got cited widely, exposing how easily LLM answer engines launder nonsense.

items.title: A certificate authority lost intermediate keys
items.oneliner: Eight eMudhra intermediate CA keys were compromised, a reminder that trust chains still fail at terrifying scale.

items.title: Tor removed hundreds of hostile exit nodes
items.oneliner: 333 Tor exit nodes were pulled after Ebury-backed MITM activity, showing old SSH hygiene failures still cascade.

items.title: Federal agencies must remove DeepSeek
items.oneliner: DHS ordered civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products, turning geopolitical AI risk into an immediate procurement constraint.

items.title: DeepSeek open-sourced its inference engine
items.oneliner: DeepSeek released DeepInfer under Apache 2.0, giving teams another production inference stack tuned beyond Nvidia-only assumptions.

items.title: TypeScript got a serious Rust rewrite
items.oneliner: Cloudflare and partners say tsrs is up to 8x faster with 70% less memory, raising expectations for dev tooling.
